title: Seta configuration (seta.yaml)
description: Declares the domains Seta checks and how findings are treated. Values may reference environment variables as ${VAR}; an unset variable is an error.

resolver.description: DNS resolver used for all checks. Defaults to the system resolver.

servers.description: Same values as --resolver: "system", "doh" (DNS over HTTPS), "dot" (DNS over TLS), IP[:port], tls://host[:port] or https://host/path.

timeout.description: Timeout for one query to one server (default 5s).

skip_check.description: Don't verify that the resolver answers correctly before running. A resolver that drops records turns existing records into false findings.

defaults.description: Settings every target inherits unless it sets its own.

checks.description: Checks to run (default: all). Globs such as "email.*"; a leading "!" excludes.

active.description: Run active checks, which connect to the target's servers (default false).

targets.description: Domains to check. Only list domains you own or are authorized to test.

severity_overrides.description: Report a check's findings at a different severity, by check ID.

suppressions.description: Findings you accept. Each needs a reason; expired suppressions stop applying and are warned about.

state.description: Where 'seta daemon' keeps findings between runs.

resolve_after.description: Runs a finding must be absent from before it is reported resolved (default 2), so a flaky answer doesn't send "resolved" followed by "new".

retention.description: How long run history and resolved findings are kept (default 90d).

notify.description: Where 'seta daemon' sends a digest of each run's changes.

plugins_dir.description: Directory searched for seta-plugin-* executables before $PATH, relative to this file.

plugins.description: Settings for each plugin, by plugin name. A plugin only ever sees its own settings.

schedule.description: When 'seta daemon' runs, in cron syntax (default "0 */6 * * *"). Also accepts @hourly, @daily and @every 6h; prefix CRON_TZ=Europe/Berlin for a time zone.

checks.description: Checks for this target; replaces defaults.checks.

active.description: Run active checks against this target; overrides defaults.active.

hosts.description: Web hosts the tls, http and dns checks look at, as name or name:port (default port 443). Default: the domain and www.<domain>, skipped when they serve nothing; hosts listed here must be reachable.

urls.description: Pages the http checks fetch instead of each host's /.

plugins.description: Plugin settings for this target, merged key by key over the top-level plugins settings.

dkim_selectors.description: DKIM selectors the domain signs with (the s= tag of DKIM-Signature headers). Without them Seta only tries common names.

expected_mx.description: MX hosts the domain should have; email.mx.unexpected reports any difference. A leading "*." matches one label.

dnsbls.description: DNS blocklist zones to query instead of the defaults.

check.description: Check ID or glob, e.g. email.mtasts.missing or "email.dkim.*".

target.description: Only suppress findings on this target (one of targets).

subject.description: Only suppress findings about this subject, e.g. an MX host or "selector:s1".

expires.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the suppression stops applying.

name.description: Identifies the notifier in logs and 'seta notify test' (default: the type).

on.description: Changes to send (default new, regressed, resolved).

min_severity.description: Only send findings at or above this severity.

heartbeat.description: Send an all-clear message when nothing was sent for this long, e.g. weekly.

chat_id.description: Telegram chat, group or channel ID.

webhook.description: Discord webhook URL, or Slack incoming webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...). Use ${VAR}.

url.description: URL the JSON payload is POSTed to.

secret.description: Signs each payload: X-Seta-Signature-256: sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, body).

block_private_ips.description: Refuse to connect to private, loopback and link-local addresses.

host.description: SMTP server host name, without a port.

port.description: SMTP port (default 587 for starttls, 465 for tls, 25 for none).

tls.description: starttls (default): upgrade a plain connection, and fail if the server can't; tls: TLS from the start (port 465); none: no encryption, e.g. a local relay.

username.description: SMTP username; set together with password.
